title: Caption-Led News — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Lead, evidence hand-off and key fact
scenes.purpose: Read the headline first, then hand the selected term 'connected' to its matching hub node in the evidence pane and hold both with the key fact.
visuals: Serif headline in four phrase lines on the left, kept stable
Evidence pane (500x420) with an original network chart detail and corner brackets
Editorial blue #0A6FAA term highlight and cyan #5FC0F5 leader, hub and links

beats.development: Kicker slides in; headline lines 'An idea / becomes a / connected / system.' rise out of their masks in reading order.
Evidence pane opens out from a centre slot; network links draw and nodes pop in; brackets and the figure caption appear after the pane is fully open; 'connected' gets the editorial-blue highlight.
captions: FIG. 1 · DETAIL: ONE NODE, FIVE LINKS

beats.development: Leader draws from the highlighted term through the gap between text and pane to the hub; on arrival the hub, ring and its five links light up; the key-fact bar wipes in and its copy appears once the bar is complete.
captions: Every new link traces back to the first idea.

beats.development: Held result: term, leader, lit hub and key fact all stay still together.
captions: Every new link traces back to the first idea.

findings: The headline is fully readable by 0.9 s, before the evidence pane opens, as the style requires.
The key-fact copy appears at 2.32 s, so its hold is short (0.68 s) for a 3-second preview. In a full film it would need a longer hold.
justifiedHolds: 2.32–3.00 s shared hold of the linked term and its evidence, which the style requires.

notes: One paused GSAP timeline at window.__timelines.video controls every animated property. State depends only on timeline time.
No preview recipes were supplied, so the preview shows the style's main action.
